request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and steady, acoustic guitar, fingerpicked banjo, soft cello, subtle shaker, gentle flute, reflective and solemn mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The book lists the names of the returning
Israelites who settled on their land
Judah went into exile in Babylon
But now the first return to their towns

[Verse]
From the Levites came Shemaiah
Son of Hasshub of the line of Merari
And Bakbakkar stood with Heresh and Galal
Mattaniah son of Mica was there

[Chorus]
Bakbakkar Heresh Galal and Mattaniah
Sons of Mica son of Zichri son of Asaph
Serving the temple in Jerusalem
Keeping the faith of the old days

[Verse]
Obadiah son of Shemaiah followed
From the line of Galal and Jeduthun
And Berechiah son of Asa lived
Among the villages of Netophah

[Chorus]
Bakbakkar Heresh Galal and Mattaniah
Sons of Mica son of Zichri son of Asaph
Serving the temple in Jerusalem
Keeping the faith of the old days

[Bridge]
Gatekeepers Shallum Akkub and Talmon
Stationed at the King's Gate east side
Guarding the thresholds just as fathers
Kept the entrance of the LORD's camp

[Outro]
Recorded in the book of the kings
The Levites serve in the city
Bakbakkar stands in the list
Faithful after the exile.
